ruleDefinitions.name: WinSock2 Autorun Keys Modification
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects modification of autostart extensibility point (ASEP) in registry. Note: Unmapped fields: Details

sequences.query: registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\System\\\\CurrentControlSet\\\\Services\\\\WinSock2\\\\Parameters.*") AND (registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Protocol\\_Catalog9\\\\Catalog\\_Entries.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\NameSpace\\_Catalog5\\\\Catalog\\_Entries.*")) AND  NOT ((Details = "\(Empty\)" OR process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\MsiExec\.exe" OR process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\syswow64\\MsiExec\.exe"))
